Require a lifespan.shutdown.complete response and reject missing or malformed shutdown responses.

Add the RUF029 suppression to the async silent_app test helper.
Use TestClient as a context manager so its lifespan portal cannot leak when assertions fail.
Keep CORS outside the outermost Starlette error handler and cover an unhandled route error with an Origin header.
Allow transformer lifespan tasks to finish cleanup, then await cancellation before leaving the context.
